main.description: Put one raw sea turtle on the range. One call, one roll, one result: whether it burnt is turtle meat's die and not the caller's. A cook takes four ticks, and asking again inside that is refused, so the range runs at the speed a range runs at however the button is being pressed. Requires an atproto service auth token addressed to did:web:turtleme.at#turtle_game and naming this method, so a token issued for one call cannot be spent on another.
